title: 第十九章 三祖战妖圣第二十章 圣境之下第一人
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
安妙菱到达战场后，直接拔出了冰璃剑。
神色逐渐冷了起来，她开始催动自己的血脉之力。
顿时周遭温度迅速降低，最后连呼吸都带有雾气。
她把目标锁定在离她最近的荒牛妖王，也是牛妖的一种。
唰！
安妙菱携漫天的剑意怒斩而去。
荒牛妖王感受到强大的剑意后，心生退意。
但是他还没来得急退，剑光就斩了过来。
他只能去硬抗，全身肌肉暴起，举起手中的斧头猛的向前一砸。
但是安妙菱使用的是极品帝兵。
冰璃剑轻松的劈开斧头并且刺穿了荒牛妖王的身体。
一招秒杀。
顿时不少人和妖都被震惊到了。
然而这仅仅只是一个开始，后面碰到的妖王她也是一剑一个。
杀完后她还顺便把尸体收到储物戒指里面冰封了起来。
当做食材。
短短半分钟她已经杀了十个妖王，战斗力可以说是恐怖如斯。
主要也是因为极品帝兵太可怕了。
它可以轻松的破掉妖王的防御。
顿时妖王陷入了恐慌，看到安妙菱靠近就疯狂的逃跑。

而三宗这边却是露出了喜色。
金色轿子内的金龙妖圣，看到安妙菱的表现非但没有生气，反而有些高兴。
她的天赋越强，自己吞噬她的血脉后，得到的好出也就越多。
至于妖王死就死了，妖族本来就是弱肉强食。
他们之中的强者，也是吞噬了无数其它妖族才成长起来的。
就和养蛊一样，只要死的不是妖皇他就不心痛。
眼看局势要被逆转，巨猿妖皇带着几十个妖王赶来。
见到这一幕，莫问天等人也露出担忧之情。
同时也不得不承认妖族确实强者众多。
新的妖皇加入后，便开始屠杀三宗的长老和峰主。
巨力掏心！
巨猿妖皇挥舞着手臂直接破除御雷锋雷霸的防御，并且掏出了他的心脏。
随后他面带邪笑，狠狠一捏，心脏直接被捏爆了。
此后他更加开心了，仿佛是在做什么非常有趣的事情。
安妙菱看到这一幕时已经晚了。
虽然她不是很喜欢雷霸这个人。
但是她能感觉出来雷霸是真的关心她。
content_en:
After An Miaoling arrived at the battlefield, she directly drew the ice glass sword.
Her expression gradually turned cold, and she began to activate the power of her bloodline.
Suddenly, the surrounding temperature dropped rapidly, and finally even the breath was filled with mist.
She set her sights on the King of Wild Bull Demons who was closest to her, and was also a type of bull demon.
Uh-huh!
An Miaoling slashed away with sword intent that filled the sky.
After feeling the powerful sword intent, the Wild Ox Demon King decided to retreat.
But before he could retreat, the sword light struck him.
He could only resist, his muscles all over his body bulged, he raised the ax in his hand and slammed it forward.
But An Miaoling used the best imperial weapons.
The ice glass sword easily split the ax and pierced the body of the Wild Ox Demon King.
Kill instantly with one move.
Suddenly many people and demons were shocked.
However, this was just the beginning. The demon kings she encountered later also struck each one with a sword.
After the killing, she put the body into a storage ring and froze it.
As food.
In just half a minute, she had killed ten demon kings, and her fighting power could be said to be terrifying.
Mainly because the best imperial soldiers are so terrifying.
It can easily break the demon king's defense.
The demon king suddenly fell into panic and ran away frantically when he saw An Miaoling approaching.
But the three sects showed joy.
The Golden Dragon Demon Saint in the golden sedan chair was not angry when he saw An Miaoling's performance, but was actually a little happy.
The stronger her talent is, the more benefits she will get after devouring her bloodline.
As for the demon king, he will die as soon as he dies. The demon clan is originally about the weak and the strong.
The strong ones among them also grew up after devouring countless other demon clans.
Just like raising Gu, as long as the person who dies is not the Demon King, he won't feel heartbroken.
Seeing that the situation was about to be reversed, the giant ape demon king came with dozens of demon kings.
Seeing this scene, Mo Wentian and others also expressed worries.
At the same time, I have to admit that the demon clan does have many powerful people.
After the new Demon King joined, he began to massacre the elders and peak masters of the three sects.
Great effort to dig out your heart!
The Giant Ape Demon King waved his arms to directly break through Yu Lei Feng Lei Ba's defense, and took out his heart.
Then he smiled evilly and squeezed it so hard that his heart burst.
He became even happier after that, as if he was doing something very interesting.
When An Miaoling saw this scene, it was already too late.
Although she doesn't like Lei Ba very much.
But she could feel that Lei Ba really cared about her.
